items.title: Fragments: September 24
items.summary:
Rob Bowley is “flipping tables in his head” with anger at the current media coverage of the danger of AI killing us all


  The risk I’m worried about isn’t a future machine deciding to wipe us out. It’s today’s AI, being wired into everything, carelessly and fast.


Cyber attacks have already cost millions of dollars in lost economic output, often without AI being involved at all. Bowley feels the push to slow down AI is distracting us from the problems that are lurking with current technology.
